title: 2020-21 Panini Prizm Pink Fast Break Prizm #48 Kevin Porter Jr. Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2020-21 Panini Prizm trading card features Kevin Porter Jr. of the Cleveland Cavaliers, with a limited print run of only 50 copies. The card is a Fast Break Pink Prizm parallel variety, part of the base set of the National Basketball Association (NBA) trading cards produced by Panini. 

The card is not autographed and comes with serial numbering for authenticity. It is a must-have for any basketball fan and collector of sports trading cards. Get your hands on this rare and valuable piece of memorabilia today!
